newsitem.title: USA: TCF Financial completes BOC Financial buy.
newsitem.headline: TCF Financial completes BOC Financial buy.

text.p: TCF Financial Corp said Friday its TCF Bank Illinois unit completed the acquisition of BOC Financial Corp, parent of Bank of Chicago. Terms were not undisclosed.

TCF said the three Bank of Chicago offices will contine to operate under the current name until it receives final approval from banking regulators for a national charter, which is expected sometime this spring.
TCF said it will have 37 branches in the metropolitan Chicago area including the Bank of Chicago branches.
TCF is a Minneapolis-based bank holding company. Its shares were up 1/2 at 41-7/8 at midday.
